description: UTC timestamp for observation or funding period.
quality_rule: Must be timezone-aware or explicitly normalized to UTC; no duplicate timestamps per instrument/field.

description: Local symbol such as BTCUSDT mapped from derivative instrument.
quality_rule: Must map back to one of the same 19 markets; no substitute markets.

description: OKX derivative instrument ID such as BTC-USDT-SWAP.
quality_rule: Must be verified from exchange metadata during future audit.

description: Expected to be USDT-margined perpetual/swap where available.
quality_rule: Must not mix spot OHLCV, coin-margined swaps, futures expiries, or unrelated instruments without explicit labeling.
Must document units and whether value is contracts, base currency, quote currency, or USD notional.
Required for cross-market comparability; inconsistent/unknown units make data partially usable or unusable.

description: Normalized OI notional if safely derivable.
quality_rule: Do not infer silently; derivation must be documented and auditable.

description: Funding rate for current or completed funding interval.
quality_rule: Must distinguish realized/historical funding from next/predicted funding to avoid leakage.
Needed to align 8h funding to 4h candles without future leakage.

description: Next funding timestamp if returned by exchange.
quality_rule: Must not be used as predictive future data unless proven available at candle close.

description: Reference to raw response or immutable archive.
quality_rule: Improves reproducibility; absence must be documented.

description: UTC time of future audit fetch.
